title: His father as a soloist and in the Shriners Band; the Junior Shrine Band
summary: Hirsch describes his father as a soloist and assistant leader of the Shriners Band, its fine players, his own drum study and the Junior Shrine Band trip to Washington in 1923; mention of Wade Schlegel.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well, I judge he must have been a soloist from everything you've said about him.

He was a soloist. And he was assistant leader of the Shriners Band when the Shrine really had a band. I mean, they had bands. In that band, they had. Assistant to Tossel? Huh? Was he assistant to Tossel with the Shriners Band?

Not to Tossel. No, no. This was before. Before Tossel. Tossel was born, even. Okay. Okay. Tossel was two years old then. And Dr. McAfee, he was a dentist. He was a conductor. But they had Mike Kupera playing first trumpet. And Mike Kaplan. And my daddy. And another fellow. I can't remember his name, but he was good. They had four trumpet players. They were terrific players. They had Lamar Harrison playing clarinet. And this fellow, Jufria, used to be the clarinet player at the Orphium Theater. He was a very fine, legitimate clarinet player. And they had bass players that were actually good players. The whole band was good. It was a great band. I tell you, I know about the band because I was a kid then. And I was studying drums with old man Peterson. And there was another fellow by the name of George Paroletti. I don't know if you ever heard of him, George Paroletti. Well, he taught the Junior Shrine Band. I was in the Junior Shrine Band in 1923 when we went to Washington, D.C. for the ceremonial imperial council up there. But they had some good musicians around there. They had a cornet player that was in my dance band by the name of Wade Schlegel, who later changed his name to David Wade. He was with this group that played Twilight in Turkey and I can't think of the guy's name right now. I know it as well as him.
Was he related to Mark Warneau?
His brother. His brother. He changed his name too.
I know it and I can't think of it either. But it'll come.
